sn12.48:1.2: Atha kho lokāyatiko brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā || pe|| ||
sn12.48:1.3: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho lokāyatiko brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3
sn12.48:2.1: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama sabbam atthīti || ||
sn12.48:2.2: Sabbam atthīti kho brāhmaṇa jeṭṭham etam lokāyatam || || 4
sn12.48:3.1: Kim pana bho Gotama sabbaṃ natthīti || ||
sn12.48:3.2: Sabbaṃ natthīti kho brāhmaṇa dutiyaṃ etaṃ lokāyataṃ || || 5
sn12.48:4.1: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama sabbam ekattan ti ||
sn12.48:4.2: Sabbam ekattanti kho brāhmaṇa tatiyam etaṃ lokāyataṃ || || 6
sn12.48:5.1: Kiṃ pana bho Gotama sabbaṃ puthuttanti || ||
sn12.48:5.2: Sabbaṃ puthuttanti kho brāhmaṇa catuttham etaṃ lokāyatam || ||
sn12.48:6.1: Ete te brāhmaṇa ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti || || 7
sn12.48:6.4: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī || ||
sn12.48:6.7: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || || 8
sn12.48:7.1: Evaṃ vutte lokāyatiko brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
